# Local LAN thumbnail set

Generated with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-11-03 for the local #39 preview.
Ten distinct assets, lan-01.png through lan-10.png, displayed as small circular
thumbnails. No runtime image generation, image upload, remote host or paid storage.
The fixture directory is excluded from the normal production build entry.

## Prompt set

Common prompt: Generate one small square photographic website thumbnail, 512x512
if available. Cohesive friendly private LAN set: realistic editorial photography,
charcoal shadows, mint/teal accents, soft amber, crisp central subject, suitable for
circular cropping. No visible faces, text, logos, watermarks or montage.
Actual generated output is 1254x1254 PNG; UI rendering uses small circular crops.

Subjects in filename order:

- lan-01.png: compact mechanical gaming keyboard with mint backlighting beside a monitor
- lan-02.png: two gaming monitors and empty chairs at a cozy evening LAN party
- lan-03.png: gaming mouse and woven mousepad lit by cyan RGB
- lan-04.png: row of glowing PCs in a small community hall LAN night
- lan-05.png: transparent PC case with mint and teal internal lights
- lan-06.png: coiled ethernet cable and network switch beside gaming gear
- lan-07.png: over-ear gaming headphones resting on a desk with mint lighting
- lan-08.png: controller beside keyboard and game screens at a LAN weekend
- lan-09.png: top-down tabletop with pizza slices and gaming setups
- lan-10.png: atmospheric midnight LAN setup with RGB monitors and empty chairs

Each day chooses one of the ten local assets once when the preview mounts; normal
registration edits retain the same image. A reload can choose a fresh set.
